notes.title: The latest demo of Beat Souls is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274181/a92a8fa5c75ec174b5ea877fd61d0a7aa8f9fc08.png[/img]

We've created a new demo version of Beat Souls based on the full version release and hope everyone will enjoy the additional stages.

We've picked 6 full stages from the 45 in the arcade mode of the full version. Aim for the top by achieving a NO DAMAGE & FULL COMBO!

[b]Contents[/b]

• Arcade Mode 6 stages (Normal and Hard, 12 in total)
 - [Beginner] Mei – Stage 1 [MUSIC: Stair Steps / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky].
 - [Beginner] Mei – Stage 4 [MUSIC: PDG (short ver.) / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky]
 - [Intermediate] NeNe – Stage 2 [MUSIC: I Like It / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky]
 - [Intermediate] NeNe – Stage 4 [MUSIC: 8ight / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky]
 - [Advanced] Rinko – Stage 2 [MUSIC: in a Shallow sea / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky]
 - [Advanced] Rinko – Stage 4 [MUSIC: Black Hat (short ver.) / ARTIST: DJ math-cow a.k.a raven sky]
• Supported languages ​​Japanese / English / Chinese (Simplified) / Chinese (Traditional)
• Tutorial
• Help

[b]Function restrictions[/b]

• The player character is Mikoto only.
• Characters cannot be changed (only their profile’s can be viewed)
• Only 6 stages are included in the Arcade Mode (ARCADE MODE).
• Infinite hell mode (HELL MODE) is not available.
• No achievements are available.

Please follow us so that you don't miss any of the latest Beat Souls news!
Thank you for your continued support of Beat Souls.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596370/Beat_Souls/

notes.title: Introducing three important elements in Score Attack!
notes.content:
In this post, we'd like to introduce you to “Fever Time”, “Character Customization”, and “HELL Mode”, all of which are essential to achieving a high score!

[h2][b]Fever Time[/b][/h2]
When you catch a Beat Soul, your "Fever Gauge" will increase.
If you enter a fever time section while maintaining a certain amount of the gauge, it becomes fever time and the score you can earn will increase.
When aiming for a high score, try to be aware of fever time!

[img]https://game.zoo.jp/images/Steam_BeatSoulsFever1.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Character Customization[/b][/h2]
As you progress through the game, you'll be able to unlock and select other characters to challenge the stages.
Each character has a special "skill" assigned to them, so use them well and aim for a high score!

[img]https://game.zoo.jp/images/Steam_BeatSoulsFever2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Infinite Hell Mode (HELL MODE)[/b][/h2]
In this mode, there are three stages, one for each of the three Yokai characters.
In this mode, the music continues endlessly, and you can test your skills to see how long you can last to achieve the high score.
If you fail to catch the Beat Soul or hit a Noise, your "Excite Gauge" will decrease. When it reaches zero, the game is over.
This mode supports rankings, so compete with players from around the world for the high score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274181/f83da7de4c6d5975b23533d4afbe3a0079c1ff52.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
What do you think?
We'll continue to bring you more information about the game to the community here!
Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist so you don't miss out on the latest news.
We hope you will look forward to the release of the game.
